nöködtü-ji: nökör — companion, follower (plural nököd); possessive -tü, 'having companions'; accusative -ji after a vowel, 'the one with companions' (noun + plural + possessive + case, back-vowel form) [伴當(每)有的行]
elsegdežü: else- — to submit; passive -gde-, converb -žü, 'being brought to submit' (verb, passive converb, front-vowel form) [被歸附着]
bēgiṅ: Bēgiṅ — Beijing (Daning, Ming 大寗), a city (place name) [大寗]
baγudqun: baγu- — to come down, descend; of a city, 'to take, bring down' (Ming 下); plural optative/imperative -dqun, 'bring (you all) down' (verb, plural imperative; Ming 您, uncertain) [下您]
buqanu-ji: Buqanu — Buqanu, a man's name, a Jurchen; accusative -ji after a vowel, 'Buqanu (as object)' (personal name + case) [人名行]
buqanu: Buqanu — Buqanu, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
qaγ̇uludqun: qaγ̇ulu- — to hunt down, to put down, suppress (Ming 勦捕); plural imperative -dqun, 'put (him) down, you all' (verb, plural imperative; the -d- uncertain) [勦捕您]
elseġesü: else- — to submit; conditional -ġesü, 'if (one) submits' (verb, conditional, front-vowel form; Ming 呵) [歸附呵]
kižiγ̇ar: kižiγ̇ar — edge, border, frontier (noun; Ming 邊) [邊]
ula: Ula — Ula, a river name (place name) [河名]
naγ̇u: Naγ̇u — Naγu, a river name (place name) [河名]
müred: müren — river, a great river; plural -d, 'rivers' (noun + plural) [河每]
taγ̇ur: Taγ̇ur — Taγur, a river name (place name) [河名]
aγ̇uruγ-tur: aγ̇uruγ — camp, encampment (the place where the people halt); dative-locative -tur after a consonant, 'in, at the camp' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [營盤 裏]
tolun: Tolun — Tolun, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
ileldübe: ile- — to send; reciprocal/co-operative -ldü-, 'together, along with'; past -be, 'sent along' (verb, co-operative, past, front-vowel form; Ming 共) [敎共去了]
elseġülžü: else- — to submit; causative -ġül-, converb -žü, 'making submit' (verb, causative converb, front-vowel form) [敎歸附着]
mör-e: mör — road, way, track; dative-locative -e, 'on the road, along the way' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [路行]
bümüi: bü- — to be, to exist; present tense -mui, the long form, 'is, are' (verb, present) [有的]
